usedFor: Stripe records payments, and AlertKick receives monitoring changes through “Resume Monitor” and “Pause Monitor”.

bestTemplate.name: “When a payment succeeds” in Stripe, then “Resume Monitor” in AlertKick
bestTemplate.why: A successful payment can switch a paused monitor back on.

watchOut: “Pause Monitor” in AlertKick stops checks and alerts until resumed, so no alerts fire while it is paused.
